🎮 NEW CONSOLE UPDATE! Release 2.1

Welcome to Katana Arena — A fast-respawn first-person FFA samurai arena. Master your blade, unleash elemental powers, and cut down your rivals!

⚔️ Defeat opponents with your katana!
🔑 Unlock more katanas & abilities!
📦 Open crates to unlock more skins!
🏆 Climb the leaderboard!

⛩️ Available on Desktop, Phones, Tablets, XBOX, & PlayStation 5!
⭐ Premium players earn +20% in-match Credits!
👥 Play with friends to earn +20% in-match Credits!

Controls:
💻 PC — LMB: Attack | Q: Power | RMB: Block | V: Inspect | Ctrl: Crouch & Slide
📱 Mobile — Dedicated touch UI
🎮 Console — OUT NOW!

🎁 Join the group for future Katana rewards!

If you have proof of another person cheating, send it over in our channels!
🚫 Cheating will result in a permanent ban. There are no second chances!
